hitPoints.atHigherLevels: 1d8 (or 5) + your Constitution modifier per monk level after 1st

features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.description: While not wearing armor or wielding a shield, your AC equals 10 + DEX mod + WIS mod.

features.name: Martial Arts
features.description: You can use DEX instead of STR for unarmed strikes and monk weapon attacks; you can roll a d4 in place of the normal damage; and make a bonus unarmed strike after the Attack action (scales by level).

features.name: Ki
features.description: Your training allows you to harness mystic energy. You have a number of ki points equal to your monk level, regained on a short or long rest. You can use Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, and Step of the Wind.

features.name: Unarmored Movement
features.description: Your speed increases while you are not wearing armor or wielding a shield; the bonus increases as you gain levels.

features.name: Monastic Tradition
features.description: Choose a tradition that shapes your training, such as Way of the Open Hand, Way of Shadow, or Way of the Four Elements.

features.name: Deflect Missiles
features.description: You can use your reaction to deflect or catch a missile when you are hit by a ranged weapon attack.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: At 4th level, and again at 8th, 12th, 16th, and 19th, increase one ability by 2, or two abilities by 1 each, or take a feat if used.

features.name: Slow Fall
features.description: You can use your reaction to reduce falling damage you take by an amount equal to five times your monk level.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Stunning Strike
features.description: You can interfere with the flow of ki in an opponent’s body; when you hit another creature with a melee weapon attack, you can spend 1 ki to attempt a stunning strike.

features.name: Ki-Empowered Strikes
features.description: Your unarmed strikes count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage.

features.name: Evasion
features.description: You can nimbly dodge out of the way of certain area effects; on a successful DEX save you take no damage, and on a failed save half damage.

features.name: Stillness of Mind
features.description: You can use your action to end one effect on yourself that is causing you to be charmed or frightened.

features.name: Purity of Body
features.description: You are immune to disease and poison.

features.name: Tongue of the Sun and Moon
features.description: You learn to touch the ki of other minds so that you understand all spoken languages and any creature can understand you.

features.name: Diamond Soul
features.description: You gain proficiency in all saving throws. Additionally, when you fail a saving throw, you can spend 1 ki point to reroll it.

features.name: Timeless Body
features.description: Your ki sustains you so that you suffer none of the frailty of old age, and you can go longer without food and water.

features.name: Empty Body
features.description: You can use your ki to become invisible and gain resistance to all damage but force for 1 minute; you can also spend 8 ki points to cast astral projection without material components (self only).

features.name: Perfect Self
features.description: When you roll for initiative and have no ki points remaining, you regain 4 ki points.
